fns.desc: read_rsa_key_from_x509(): wc_AllocDer() allocates *key_der at :3646, but if the subsequent wc_GetPubKeyDerFromCert() write-call at :3652 fails, execution goes to fail: (:3659) which frees only cert/cert_der, never *key_der -- the allocated DerBuffer leaks. Worse, the caller crypto_rsa_key_read() only checks `if (!key_der)` (:3700) to detect failure, so on this specific path key_der is non-NULL but was never actually filled by the failed GetPubKeyDerFromCert call, and the caller proceeds to RSA-decode its (unfilled/stale) contents as if valid.
